notes: The circuit.png and relay-connection.png images were not available as readable content; the wiring follows the text: open-ended USB (+) to relay 1 NO, USB (-) joined with pump (-), pump (+) to relay 1 COM.
The MKR IoT Carrier is not in the catalogue, so I created it. Its header ports are named H.<pin>, and the Grove A6 connector and relay terminals have their own ports.
The sketch calls Relay2, while the text says relay 1. I followed the text (relay 1) and the labelled NO/COM pins.
The optional connector strip from the tip is not modelled. The wires are joined directly, as the main text describes.
The USB cable and the pump's negative wire are shown joined directly (twisted). A connector strip or wire nut could be used instead.
The plant, soil, phone and Arduino Cloud are not physical build parts and are left out. The moisture sensor sits in the soil, but that is not modelled. The wall power outlet is also left out.
Only the pipe's pump end is connected. The other end goes into the plant pot, which is not modelled.
The micro-USB cable goes from adapter port 1 to the MKR WiFi 1010 USB port. The open-ended USB cable goes to adapter port 2. Which adapter port each cable uses is an assumption.
